newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Roche stock up after Q1, good forecast.
newsitem.headline: Roche stock up after Q1, good forecast.

text.p: Participation certificates in Roche Holding AG gained about 50 Swiss francs to 11,980 Swiss francs after the pharmaceutical major reported first quarter sales growth and forecast higher 1997 profits.

The 0.4 percent price gain followed a Roche statement before bourse trading opened that first quarter sales rose 18 percent from the year before in Swiss franc terms, or three percent adjusted for currency fluctuations.

Chairman Fritz Gerber also forecast "an increase in profit for 1997 under the normal, but necessary condition that there are no unforeseen events," according to the text of a speech prepared for a news conference.
